title: AC1032 section-map and proxy/custom-object stage crosswalk
mode: Primary-source open-source DWG/DXF peer research plus local source/test crosswalk and focused regression verification
scope: Refresh LibreDWG and ACadSharp evidence for section-map/page failures, opaque proxy data, custom-object interpretation, and route-specific limitations.
Compare current FreeCAD DWG-to-DXF consumer documentation with the planned 2D and ACIS qualification gates.
Reconcile the prior PAR-132/7CB proxy body-dispatch coverage gap with the current generated local test and update the plan without transferring peer failures to libdxfrw.

sources.revision: Issue page and current repository source reviewed 2026-10-19; issue reports LibreDWG 0.13.4 and 0.13.4.8317.
sources.observed: The issue reporter describes one unavailable private AC1032 drawing failing in section metadata/page sizing before object decode, while twelve same-producer R2018 controls reportedly pass, including larger files. The author offers a structural log or local execution against the private file.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-reported failure profile only. No DWG was available or downloaded, no current LibreDWG binary was run, and this is not evidence of a libdxfrw defect or a format rule.

sources.revision: Current PR, commit, release, and discussion pages reviewed 2026-10-19. #1274 merged to master on 2026-10-13; #1275 remains open. Latest listed v3.8.0 release predates the #1274 merge.
sources.observed: #1274 adds a DWG opaque proxy-data path bounded by a handle-section offset, with the PR stating its boundary is available for R2010+; review removes a DXF group-311 promise because the DXF reader/writer path does not support it. #1275 is a narrow, still-open TArch/Tianzheng text interpretation proposal and compares selected properties to vendor-flattened output. Its discussion reports different counts across revisions and separately notes a DXF ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY drop in ACadSharp.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Merged source and contributor reports establish peer implementation activity, not package inclusion, independent semantic support, native acceptance, or local behavior. No ACadSharp package/build was run.

sources.observed: The documented DWG path uses an external converter to produce DXF, then a selectable stock DXF importer; the docs state that the stock importer cannot read ACIS/SAT solids and describe differing C++ and legacy importer subsets.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documented product scope only; no FreeCAD binary, converter, or native consumer was run.

sources.project: Local generated proxy-dispatch test and owning CTest
sources.revision: Shared worktree at de27a33 with extensive uncommitted changes; focused build and test run on 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: The existing --proxy-entity-dispatch test generates AC1024 and AC1032 proxy frames in memory. It checks non-byte-aligned entity-data bits, ordered object-ID references, independent proxy-graphics fields/bytes, raw fallback identity, following LINE continuity, and refusal without partial callbacks for malformed/truncated frames. Strict target build passed; the selector passed; the existing libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix CTest passed 1/1 in 1.51 seconds.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Generated local object-frame/dispatch coverage, not full-file class/section integration, producer interoperability, unknown custom-object interpretation, DXF/DWG cross-format parity, or ACIS semantics. No production code was changed in this research pass.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-14/PAR-26 AC1032 R2004+ section-map/page-size acceptance criteria
PAR-07/S8 separation of proxy/custom-object carriers and ACIS semantics
FreeCAD 2D consumer route versus independent ACIS qualification
assessment.planImpact: Keep the new LibreDWG AC1032 section-map failure as a version-specific external adversarial profile under existing parser owners. Close the already-implemented generated proxy body-dispatch gap while keeping whole-file integration and cross-format/custom semantics separate. Reaffirm that FreeCAD stock DWG conversion/import only qualifies its 2D route, not ACIS geometry. No scope, queue, dependency, fixture, or support claim change.

implementationReadiness: For AC1032 section/page changes, read the relevant ODA v5.4.1 sections before production edits and require a public structural trace, a legal sample under approved handling, or a from-scratch spec-backed control; do not infer parser policy from the issue diagnostic values.
Retain the generated --proxy-entity-dispatch selector and owning CTest as a fast body-level regression. It covers AC1024/AC1032, not full class/section discovery.

If whole-file proxy integration is required by an explicit support claim, add only a generated in-memory test to the existing reader-matrix target; assert class/handle lookup, owner/reference closure, callback identity, and sentinel continuity.
At composed peer checkpoints, pin peer commit and release independently; track DWG raw proxy data, DXF proxy groups, proxy graphics, typed semantics, and native behavior as separate evidence fields.
Keep FreeCAD's converter and selected DXF importer explicit. Its stock 2D projection cannot close ACIS B-rep or general 3D support claims.
Update the plan summary and receipt after each next implementation slice; do not wait on external issue authors or require peer/native work for unrelated ready local tasks.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus local read-only source/test crosswalk and scoped fast validation
